name: JNT Hair Shampoo
description:
Cleanses. Hydrates. Restores Moisture 
A Luxurious Cleansing Experience

Elevate your wash-day ritual with JNT Hair Shampoo, a thoughtfully formulated hair cleanser designed to cleanse the hair and scalp while helping maintain essential moisture.

Created with a focus on cleansing, hydration and moisture balance, its formula brings together carefully selected ingredients to leave your hair feeling fresh, soft and manageable without making your wash day feel harsh or stripping.

More than a cleansing step, JNT Hair Shampoo is the beginning of a considered hair-care ritual — preparing your hair for the nourishment and conditioning that follow.

What Makes It Special

	•	Gentle Cleansing: Helps remove everyday buildup and impurities from the hair and scalp.
	•	Hydration Support: Helps maintain moisture during the cleansing process.
	•	Moisture Balance: Designed to cleanse without unnecessarily leaving the hair feeling dry.
	•	A Thoughtful Formula: Combines cleansing agents with moisture-supporting and conditioning ingredients.
	•	Everyday Hair Care: A hydrating shampoo designed to complement a consistent hair-care routine.

Who Is It For?

Designed for anyone looking to incorporate cleansing and moisture care into their routine, JNT Hair Shampoo is intended for all hair types.

How to Use

	1.	Thoroughly wet your hair with lukewarm water.
	2.	Apply an appropriate amount of shampoo to your scalp and gently massage with your fingertips.
	3.	Work the lather through your hair without rough rubbing.
	4.	Rinse thoroughly. Repeat if needed.

description:

Your Hair-Care Ritual

Make every wash an opportunity to care for your hair. For a complete hair-care experience, follow JNT Hair Shampoo with JNT Hair Conditioner, then continue your routine with the JNT products best suited to your hair’s needs.

From cleansing and conditioning to moisturising and styling, each step is an opportunity to give your hair the care it deserves.

JNT — Thoughtful Formulations. Elevated Hair Care.

JNT Hair Conditioner 

Conditions. Softens. Detangles

The Art of Soft, Manageable Hair

Complete your wash-day ritual with JNT Hair Conditioner, a luxurious rinse-out conditioner designed to replenish the feeling of softness, improve manageability and make detangling easier.

Thoughtfully formulated with conditioning and moisture-supporting ingredients, it helps reduce friction between strands, allowing the hair to feel smoother, softer and easier to handle after washing.

From the moment you begin detangling to the final rinse, JNT Hair Conditioner brings comfort and care to your routine, helping your hair feel conditioned without the need for a separate deep-conditioning treatment every wash.

What Makes It Special

	•	Moisture Support: Helps the hair feel hydrated, conditioned and soft.
	•	Silky Softness: Helps improve the feel and smoothness of the hair.
	•	Detangling Support: Provides slip to help ease the process of working through knots.
	•	Improved Manageability: Helps make the hair easier to comb, style and handle.
	•	A Conditioning Ritual: Complements your shampoo to create a more complete wash-day experience.

Who Is It For?

Designed for all hair types seeking softness, conditioning and easier detangling as part of a regular hair-care routine.

How to Use

	1.	After shampooing, gently squeeze excess water from your hair.
	2.	Apply an appropriate amount of conditioner through the lengths and ends.
	3.	Distribute evenly using your fingers or a wide-tooth comb, working gently through tangles.
	4.	Leave on briefly to allow the hair to become conditioned.
	5.	Rinse thoroughly.

Use after JNT Hair Shampoo whenever you wash your hair. Adjust the amount according to your hair’s length, density and needs.

Your Hair-Care Ritual

Beautifully cared-for hair begins with the right balance of cleansing and conditioning. Pair JNT Hair Conditioner with JNT Hair Shampoo for a considered routine that leaves your hair feeling clean, soft and manageable.

JNT — thoughtful formulations. Elevated hair care.

name: Velvet Hair Cream
description:
Moisture. Softness. Definition. Manageability.

Velvet Hair Cream is a rich yet lightweight hair cream formulated to moisturize, hydrate and condition the hair while helping it remain soft, manageable and easier to style.

Its silky, velvety texture provides lasting moisture without the heavy, greasy feeling of a traditional butter.

Designed for moisture care, styling, protective styles, wash-and-gos and length-retention routines, Velvet helps keep your hair feeling soft, nourished, hydrated and beautifully manageable.

WHAT IS VELVET HAIR CREAM?

Velvet is a moisture-focused hair cream created to help grow your hair, give the hair the hydration, conditioning and softness it needs while helping maintain moisture for longer.

It combines selected botanical and cosmetic ingredients with a silky cream texture that spreads easily through the hair without feeling excessively thick.

Whether your hair is curly, coily, wavy or straight, Velvet is designed to complement & defined your natural texture while making your hair easier to manage.

WHAT IS IT DESIGNED TO DO?

Velvet Hair Cream is designed to:

	•	Moisturize and hydrate the hair
	•	Help maintain moisture
	•	Soften dry and brittle hair
	•	Improve manageability
	•	Make detangling easier
	•	Help with knots and tangles
	•	Reduce the feeling of dryness
	•	Reduce frizz
	•	Support growth & length retention
	•	Help minimize breakage associated with dryness and manipulation
	•	Enhance natural-looking shine
	•	Support styling and protective hairstyles
	•	Help define curls and natural texture
	•	Keep hair feeling soft between applications
	•	Support a healthy hair-care routine

WHO IS IT FOR?

Velvet is designed for all hair textures and hair types.

It is suitable for:

	•	Curly hair
	•	Coily hair
	•	Wavy hair
	•	Straight hair
	•	Natural hair
	•	Texturized or chemically treated hair
	•	Dry or brittle hair
	•	Hair that becomes dry easily
	•	Hair that needs more softness and manageability

It can be incorporated into routines for men and women and can also be used for children’s hair according to their individual hair-care needs.

WHAT MAKES VELVET DIFFERENT?

While XTENTION Hair Oil focuses more heavily on botanical oil nourishment, scalp care and length retention, and XTREME Growth Hair Serum provides lightweight, targeted scalp care, Velvet is your moisture and conditioning companion.

Velvet was created for the moments when your hair needs:

Moisture.
Softness.
Slip.
Manageability.
Definition.
Conditioning.

It is especially useful when detangling, styling, refreshing the hair or preparing it for a protective style.

THE VELVET FEEL

Silky.
Velvety.
Rich.
Lightweight.
Non-greasy.
Moisturizing.
Easy to spread.

Velvet is rich enough to leave a noticeable conditioning feel on the hair without becoming heavy like a traditional butter.

It absorbs easily while leaving the hair feeling soft, conditioned and moisturized.

The conditioning feel can remain noticeable on the hair beyond the initial application, helping your hair stay soft and manageable between applications.

SELECTED FORMULATION INGREDIENTS

Theobroma Cacao Seed Butter
Butyrospermum Parkii Butter
Glycerin
NIACINAMIDE 
Tocopheryl Acetate 
Dipropylene Glycol
EMULSIFIERS

Additional formulation details remain proprietary.

HOW TO USE

Apply Velvet Hair Cream to clean, conditioned or moisturized hair.

It can be applied to dry hair or slightly damp hair. Avoid applying it to excessively wet hair.

Work a suitable amount through the hair, focusing on the lengths and ends where dryness and tangling are more common.

For detangling, distribute through sections of the hair and gently work through knots and tangles.

For styling, apply before or during styling to improve softness, manageability and definition.

Velvet can also be incorporated into LOC or LCO routines as part of your moisturizing and sealing process.

WHEN TO USE IT

Velvet can be used:

	•	After wash day
	•	Before styling
	•	After styling
	•	During protective styling
	•	Under protective styles
	•	For wash-and-go styles
	•	When refreshing dry hair
	•	Whenever your hair begins to feel dry or difficult to manage

RECOMMENDED USE

Velvet is generally used 3–4 times per week, but your hair’s individual moisture needs should determine how often you reapply it.

If your hair becomes dry more quickly, Velvet can be reapplied as needed.

Because it is a richer conditioning cream, it does not necessarily need to be applied every day.

A 250 ml jar can last significantly longer when used every few days rather than as a daily moisturizer. Actual product longevity depends on hair length, density, thickness, styling habits and the amount used per application.

VELVET & LENGTH RETENTION

Healthy-looking length is not only about how quickly hair grows.

Moisture, softness, reduced breakage, proper detangling and consistent care all contribute to your ability to retain the length your hair naturally produces.

Velvet supports this part of the journey by helping keep the hair moisturized, conditioned and easier to manage.

By helping reduce dryness, tangling and breakage associated with manipulation, Velvet can support the retention of healthy-looking length while contributing to an overall hair-care routine.

VELVET FOR YOUR TEXTURE

Curly hair: Helps enhance definition while keeping curls soft and manageable.

Coily hair: Provides moisture, softness and slip to make detangling and styling easier.

Wavy hair: Adds conditioning and softness without requiring a heavy butter-like texture.

Straight hair: Helps maintain softness, shine and manageability while complementing the hair’s natural finish.

WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY

Customers often describe Velvet as making their hair feel softer, more hydrated, fresher and much easier to manage.

Some of the feedback we’ve received includes:

“My curls are actually more defined. It feels like I’m using a curl activator.”

“My scalp feels so freaking cool.”

“I noticed less breakage.”

“My hair is much easier to detangle, whether I use a brush or finger-detangle.”

“I have fewer knots and tangles.”

“My hair is much more manageable, especially when I use it with my other JNT products.”

“My hair feels so soft and hydrated.”

“My hair smells amazing.”

Customers have also shared that their hair feels lightweight, fresh, stronger and healthier while using Velvet consistently.

Some customers have noticed continued hair growth while using Velvet, even when they were not consistently using the other JNT products.

The strongest recurring experience is centered around softness, hydration, easier detangling, improved manageability, curl definition and length retention.

Because healthier-feeling, better-conditioned hair is easier to manage and less prone to breakage from dryness and manipulation, Velvet can play an important role in a consistent length-retention routine.

Individual results vary depending on hair characteristics, scalp condition, routine, consistency and other factors.

CONSISTENCY MATTERS

Velvet is not an overnight solution or a replacement for a complete hair-care routine.

Healthy-looking hair requires consistent care, including proper cleansing, hydration, moisture, gentle manipulation, protective practices and attention to your individual hair needs.

Your hair is always changing. Your routine should be intentional enough to change with it.


Intentional Hair Care. An Elevated Ritual. A Touch That Makes a Difference.

name: Mineral Hair Mist
description:
Botanical Scalp Hydration • Everyday Nourishment • Fresh Care

WHAT IS IT?

The JNT Herbal Hair Mist is a lightweight, water-based botanical mist infused with 20 different herbs, formulated to hydrate and nourish the scalp while supporting a consistent hair-growth routine.

It is intentionally simple and predominantly botanical, with glycerin included to help provide lightweight hydration.

The complete formulation remains proprietary.

WHAT IS IT DESIGNED TO DO?

The Herbal Hair Mist is designed to:

	•	Nourish the scalp
	•	Hydrate the scalp and hair
	•	Support healthy hair growth
	•	Refresh the scalp
	•	Provide lightweight hydration
	•	Prepare the hair for moisturizing and styling
	•	Keep the scalp feeling fresh and comfortable
	•	Complement your everyday hair-care routine

Its primary focus is scalp nourishment, hydration and support for healthy hair growth rather than length retention.

WHO IS IT FOR?

The Herbal Hair Mist is suitable for all hair types and textures, including:

	•	Curly hair
	•	Coily hair
	•	Wavy hair
	•	Straight hair
	•	Natural hair
	•	Texturized hair
	•	Chemically treated hair
	•	Protective styles

It can be used by both men and women and incorporated into children’s hair-care routines according to their individual needs.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT?

The Herbal Hair Mist is designed to keep your routine simple.

Unlike heavier products, it provides a lightweight, water-based way to hydrate and refresh the scalp and hair.

It can be used on its own or paired with other JNT products depending on what your hair needs.

Use it before your moisturizer, cream, oil, butter or styling product when your hair or scalp needs hydration.

TEXTURE & FEEL

Watery • Lightweight • Refreshing • Cooling • Fast-absorbing

The mist feels light on application and absorbs quickly without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling.

When used cold from the refrigerator, it provides an especially refreshing sensation on the scalp.

FORMULATION HIGHLIGHTS

20 Botanical Herbs
Glycerin
Preservative system

The complete botanical blend and formulation remain proprietary.

HOW TO USE

Shake well before use.

Spray directly onto the scalp and hair, concentrating on the areas that need hydration.

Gently massage the scalp after application.

The mist can be used alone or followed by your preferred JNT product.

For styling, lightly mist your hair before applying your hair cream, oil, butter or other styling product.

It can also be used during protective styling to refresh and hydrate the scalp and hair.

HOW OFTEN SHOULD I USE IT?

The Herbal Hair Mist is designed for everyday use.

Use once or twice daily according to your hair and scalp needs.

For a consistent routine, 5–7 times per week is ideal.

You can adjust the frequency depending on how your hair and scalp respond.

THE HERBAL MIST IN YOUR ROUTINE

Think of the Herbal Hair Mist as your hydration and scalp-nourishment step.

Mist → Moisturize → Seal/Style

You can pair it with XTENTION Hair Oil, Xtreme Growth Hair Serum, Velvet Hair Cream or another suitable product depending on your individual hair-care needs.

While hydration and scalp care are important parts of maintaining healthy hair, the Herbal Hair Mist is not positioned as a dedicated length-retention product.


WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY

Customers often tell us that the Herbal Hair Mist has become an easy part of their everyday hair-care routine.

Some customers use the mist on its own, while others pair it with XTENTION Hair Oil, Xtreme Growth Hair Serum or Velvet Hair Cream depending on their individual hair needs.

Common feedback includes:

	•	“My hair is growing.”
	•	“My scalp feels fresh and hydrated.”
	•	“My hair feels healthier.”
	•	“I noticed better growth when I stayed consistent.”
	•	“It feels so refreshing on my scalp.”
	•	“It makes my routine so much easier.”

Many customers also report noticing positive changes in their hair growth while using the mist as part of their routine, whether alone or alongside other JNT products.

CONSISTENCY MATTERS

The Herbal Hair Mist is not a magic overnight growth solution.

Healthy hair growth is a process that requires consistency and proper care.

Your overall routine, scalp care, hydration, nutrition, cleansing habits, protective styling and how you handle your hair can all play a role in maintaining healthy hair.

Use the mist consistently and give your hair the care it needs.

Keep the bottle properly closed when not in use.

JNT Intentional Hair Care. An Elevated Ritual. A Touch That Makes a Difference.

name: Xtreme Growth Hair Serum
description:
Lightweight, fast-absorbing scalp care for growth, retention & healthier-looking hair.

XTREME Growth Hair Serum is a lightweight scalp and hair serum formulated to support healthy-looking hair growth, scalp care, length retention and stronger, fuller-looking hair.

Designed to feel soothing and refreshing on the scalp, its lightweight texture absorbs quickly without leaving a heavy or greasy finish.

WHAT IS XTREME GROWTH HAIR SERUM?

XTREME is a carefully formulated blend of lightweight cosmetic, botanical and conditioning ingredients designed to make scalp and hair care simple, comfortable and consistent.

The formula combines selected humectants, conditioning agents, vitamins and botanical ingredients to support the scalp and hair while providing a smooth, fresh and easily absorbed finish.

SELECTED FORMULATION INGREDIENTS

Propylene Glycol
Pentylene Glycol
Glycerin
Extracts
Hydrolyzed Keratin 
+ 15 additional formulation ingredients

Additional formulation details remain proprietary.

WHAT IS IT DESIGNED TO DO?

XTREME Growth Hair Serum is designed to support:

	•	Healthy-looking hair growth
	•	Length retention
	•	Scalp nourishment
	•	Hairline care
	•	Fuller-looking hair
	•	Thicker-looking hair
	•	Reduced breakage
	•	Reduced frizz
	•	A soothed, refreshed scalp
	•	Healthier-looking strands

It can also be incorporated into beard and moustache care routines.

WHO IS IT FOR?

XTREME is for anyone who wants targeted, lightweight care for their scalp and hair.

It is especially suited for people concerned about:

	•	Thinning or fragile-looking hair
	•	Hairline concerns
	•	Breakage
	•	Difficulty retaining length
	•	Hair that lacks fullness
	•	Dry or uncomfortable-feeling scalp
	•	Frizz and dryness

Suitable for men and women and for a wide range of hair textures and styles.

It can be incorporated into the routines of both younger and older users according to their individual hair-care needs.

WHAT MAKES XTREME DIFFERENT?

XTREME was created for people who prefer a lighter alternative to traditional hair oils.

Its lightweight, fast-absorbing texture makes it easy to apply directly to the scalp without the heavy or greasy feeling some oils can leave behind.

It works beautifully on its own and can also be paired with XTENTION Hair Oil as part of a more complete scalp and hair-care routine.

For customers who enjoy using both, the serum provides lightweight targeted care while XTENTION provides botanical oil nourishment and everyday length-retention support.

THE XTREME FEEL

Lightweight.
Cooling.
Fresh.
Fast-absorbing.
Non-greasy.
Comfortable.

XTREME leaves the scalp feeling refreshed while providing a smooth finish that fits easily into your routine.

Its fresh, pleasant fragrance makes the application experience even more enjoyable.

HOW TO USE

Apply a generous amount directly to the scalp, focusing on areas that need extra attention.

Massage thoroughly with your fingertips to distribute the serum evenly.

Depending on your hairstyle, you may also apply the serum to your palms, rub your hands together and gently work it through the scalp and hair.

A small amount may also be applied to the lengths and ends where dryness, frizz or breakage is a concern.

XTREME is a leave-in serum and does not need to be washed out after application.

RECOMMENDED USE

Use 3-5 times per week, or incorporate it into your routine according to your individual hair and scalp needs.

It can be applied during the day or at night.

For wash-day routines, apply it as part of your normal scalp-care routine before or after styling, depending on your routine and hairstyle.

XTREME + XTENTION

Many customers choose to use XTREME alongside XTENTION Hair Oil.

The serum provides a lightweight, fast-absorbing layer of targeted scalp care, while XTENTION provides botanical oil nourishment and support for length retention.

The two can be used together as part of a consistent hair-care routine.

THE XTREME EXPERIENCE

Customers have shared experiences such as:

“The serum gives me better results when I use it with the oil.”
“My hairline looks fuller.”
“My hair feels thicker.”
“My scalp feels so much better.”
“My hair is breaking less.”
“My hair feels softer and healthier.”

Individual results vary depending on hair characteristics, scalp condition, routine, consistency and other factors.

CONSISTENCY MATTERS

XTREME is not a magic overnight solution.

Healthy-looking hair takes consistency, proper care and time.

No serum can replace a complete hair-care routine. Cleansing, hydration, moisture, protective practices, nutrition and consistent scalp and strand care all play a role in your overall hair journey.

Give your hair the attention it deserves.
Give your scalp a routine.
Stay consistent.

JNT Intentional Hair Care. An Elevated Ritual. A Touch That Makes a Difference.

Ayurvedic-inspired care for scalp nourishment, healthy-looking hair & length retention.

Lightweight, rich and easily absorbed, XTENTION is designed for everyday use without leaving the scalp feeling excessively greasy.

The formulation contains 33 Ayurvedic herbs and 20+ natural oils, selected with a focus on scalp nourishment, strand care, breakage reduction and length retention.

XTENTION Hair Oil is designed to support:

	•	Fuller-looking hair

WHY XTENTION?

Your hair is growing — but keeping the length you gain requires intentional care.

XTENTION was created around the belief that growth and retention go hand in hand. Consistent scalp and strand care can help you maintain the progress you make instead of continually losing length to breakage.

Unlike a heavier oil designed only for occasional use, XTENTION is created to fit naturally into an everyday hair-care routine while maintaining a lightweight, easily absorbed feel.

WHO IS IT FOR?

XTENTION is for anyone who wants to be more intentional about caring for their hair and scalp.

	•	Thin or fragile-looking hair

Whether your goal is to grow your hair longer, maintain the length you’ve worked for, achieve fuller-looking hair, or simply build a healthier scalp and hair-care routine, XTENTION is designed to support your journey.

Whether your hair is natural, texturized, straightened or chemically treated, XTENTION can be incorporated into a consistent hair-care routine.

Suitable for both men and women.

Apply a small amount directly to the scalp using the applicator tip.

Massage thoroughly with your fingertips until the oil is distributed across the scalp and comfortably absorbed.

A small amount may also be applied to the lengths and ends, especially where dryness, frizz or breakage is a concern.

Use enough to nourish the scalp without oversaturating it.

Individual results vary depending on hair characteristics, scalp condition, routine, consistency and other factors.

XTENTION is not a magic overnight solution.

Healthy-looking hair is built through consistent care.

Cleansing, conditioning, hydration, moisture, protective practices and an intentional routine all contribute to your overall hair-care journey.

Your hair is always growing. The goal is to create the conditions and habits that help you care for and retain the length you grow.

Grow it. Care for it. Retain it.
